reason: This plugin is primarily an in-browser notification utility for DSH Web sessions, playing configured local meme audio on specific conversation/task events with user-facing controls for volume, enabling, and clip replacement, as documented in its README and package manifest.

summaries.zh: 《牛来》音效插件是 DeepSeek Harness Web 的会话提示音工具，会在发送消息和任务完成时触发音效，并提供界面设置用于开关、音量和本地音频替换。
summaries.en: This plugin adds session audio cues to DSH Web by playing sounds on user message send and task-complete events, with a browser settings interface for enabling, volume control, and local clip replacement.

capabilities: Plays browser-based notification sounds on chat/task lifecycle events.
Allows user-configurable local audio clip replacement via the settings UI.
Observes session state to trigger one sound per send/completion event.

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as a DeepSeek Harness Web sound board that plays clips when a user sends a message and when a task completes.
README explains settings for enable/disable, volume, preview, replacing local audio files, and reset behavior.
README states all audio is in-browser via Web Audio and includes embedded clips, with no external services required for normal operation.
package.json marks the plugin as a DSH web client plugin with no external runtime service dependencies declared.
